subject.title: [Security] Mitigating timing attacks in GitHub Auth OAuth callback validation

question: Does any supported or shipped OpenClaw GitHub authentication surface accept an OAuth callback and compare a CSRF `state` value outside `extensions/github-copilot/login.ts`?
rationale: Current source and docs show only device-code polling, but the protected security label requires an owner to confirm the complete shipped boundary before closure.

options.title: Confirm absence and close
options.body: Verify the latest release artifact has no GitHub OAuth callback surface, then close this unsupported report with the device-flow evidence.

options.title: Escalate the concrete path
options.body: If another callback implementation exists, identify its exact file and shipped version and move reproducible details into private security handling.

recommendation.title: Confirm absence and close
recommendation.body: Verify the latest release artifact has no GitHub OAuth callback surface, then close this unsupported report with the device-flow evidence.
